svg.title: The electromagnetic spectrum
svg.desc: The electromagnetic spectrum on a logarithmic frequency scale from 1 Hz to beyond 10^24 Hz, with wavelengths from 3 × 10^6 m to 3 × 10^−14 m above. Radio waves run up to about 10^12 Hz and include AM radio near 10^6 Hz and TV and FM radio near 10^8 Hz; microwaves run from about 10^9 to 10^12 Hz; infrared from about 10^11 Hz to the narrow band of visible light near 10^14.7 Hz; ultraviolet from there to about 10^16.5 Hz; X rays from about 10^16 to 10^20 Hz; and gamma rays from about 10^18 Hz upward. Some categories overlap.
